title: Uploaded Files
subtitle: Upload contract PDFs and link each file to the correct contract. Files are shown with the original device filename.
uploadHint: Select one or more PDF files, then choose which contract each file belongs to before uploading.
contractRequired: Choose a contract for every file before uploading.
relinkSuccess: File linked to the selected contract
relinkFailed: Could not link the file to that contract

errors.pdfRequired: Choose at least one PDF file
errors.pdfSizeInvalid: PDF must be between 1 byte and 10 MB
errors.pdfContentInvalid: The file is not a valid PDF
errors.pdfDuplicate: This PDF is already linked to that contract
errors.contractNotEditable: Only active or draft contracts can receive files
errors.pdfRelinkFailed: Could not move the file to the selected contract
